hooks.name: No Date.now() in Game Core
hooks.description: Fails with a clear error message if any saved file inside src/lib/game/ contains Date.now( or new Date() without arguments. Enforces the injectable-clock rule: all game logic must accept a `now: number` parameter instead of reading the system clock directly.

action.command: node -e "const c=[];process.stdin.on('data',d=>c.push(d));process.stdin.on('end',()=>{let f;try{f=JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(c).toString()).file_path;}catch(e){process.exit(0);}if(!f)process.exit(0);const fs=require('fs');let s;try{s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8');}catch(e){process.exit(0);}const p=/Date\\.now\\(|new Date\\(\\s*\\)/;const v=s.split(/\r?\n/).map((l,i)=>({l,n:i+1})).filter(({l})=>p.test(l));if(!v.length)process.exit(0);process.stderr.write(['','\u{1F6AB} Injectable-clock violation in '+f,'src/lib/game/ must never call Date.now() or new Date() directly.','Accept a now:number parameter or Clock interface instead.','','Offending lines:',...v.map(x=>'  '+x.n+': '+x.l.trim()),''].join('\n'));process.exit(1);})"
